task_title: Deterministic playtest personas and fun evaluator

plan_review.notes: Reject-with-changes; all four concerns adopted. (1) A persona label can be false once --aggression/--pathing-mode/--decision-mode override the preset, so a diverging run is now left UNLABELLED (personaConfigDivergence) instead of contaminating the cohort. (2) Baseline comparisons were composition-blind; matchCohorts now downgrades every measured status to inconclusive when run count or persona share drifts >10%. (3) survivability_variance advertised target 0.28 but was healthy at >=0.14 and treated more variance as always better; it is now an explicit 0.14-0.45 band compared by distance to band. (4) experienced_player is derived from DEFAULT_CONFIG by construction rather than a copied literal. No alternative architecture warranted.
